name: application-loaders
title: Loaders
description: Loading and progress indicator components for web applications. Includes spinners, progress bars, and animated loaders for data fetching states in dashboards, forms, and content-heavy applications.
useWhen: Loading and progress indicator components for web applications. Includes spinners, progress bars, and animated loaders for data fetching states in dashboards, forms, and content-heavy applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid loaders when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Loaders uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
